# Amni Coorg

> A private luxury cottage and sanctuary estate in Coorg, Karnataka, India.

Amni Coorg is a rare, secluded retreat in the highlands of Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka. It is a two-bedroom private cottage nestled within a vast, untouched private estate, offering an immersive experience in one of India's most breathtaking natural landscapes.

## About

Amni is not a hotel. It is a family estate — built stone by stone over generations by the Coorgi family who still live on the land. What began as wild, remote wilderness was slowly shaped into a sanctuary by its founders, who saw its potential when others did not. The name "Amni" is rooted in this history of resilience and belonging.

Guests have the full cottage exclusively to themselves, surrounded by the sounds, sights, and silences of the deep Coorg forest.

## The Cottage

- **Type:** Private, exclusive-use cottage
- **Bedrooms:** 2 well-appointed rooms
- **Capacity:** Up to 5 guests
- **Features:** Private verandahs with estate views, stone fireplace in the central living room, no televisions (by design), natural light, traditional Coorgi architecture
- **Setting:** Deep within a private family estate; no other guests on the property

## Location

- **Region:** Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka, India
- **Nearest Town:** Madikeri (~15 km)
- **Access:** By road; best approached from Bangalore or Mysore

## Dining

All meals are served at the family home, a two-minute walk from the cottage. The cuisine is homestyle and wholesome — traditional Coorg flavours using locally sourced ingredients. Meals are prepared by the family and served at a shared table. There is no restaurant or buffet; it is a genuine home-cooked experience.

## Experience Highlights

- Stone fireplace for cool Coorg evenings
- Open-air bonfires on the lawn under unpolluted night skies
- Waterfalls, fruit trees, and a dark-water creek on the estate
- Complete privacy — no other guests, no resort atmosphere
- Birdsong, mist, and the rhythms of the natural world

## What Makes Amni Different

Amni is deliberately not a resort. It is intentionally small — one cottage, one family, one piece of wild land. The focus is on depth of experience over breadth of amenity. Guests describe it as feeling like staying with family, in the middle of a forest.
